crossRefs.note: Yahweh’s angel appeared to him, and said to him, “Yahweh is with you, you mighty man of valor!”

Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help…
Don’t be afraid, you worm Jacob, and you men of Israel. I will help you,” says Yahweh. “Your Redeemer is the Holy One…
teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.”…

The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.

people.name: Midian
people.line: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges

translations.web: Yahweh said to him, “Surely I will be with you, and you shall strike the Midianites as one man.”
translations.bsb: “Surely I will be with you,” the LORD replied, “and you will strike down all the Midianites as one man.”
translations.kjv: And the LORD said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.
translations.asv: And Jehovah said unto him, Surely I will be with thee, and thou shalt smite the Midianites as one man.
